## `langwatch/api-context-services`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isFeatureApi
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-api-context-services.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `construction`
  - what: `new {{name}}` inside an API class.
  - fix: Take it from `context.app` and let the composition root construct it.
- `contextCast`
  - what: API context is already typed; do not cast it to recover application services.
  - fix: Remove the cast and use `context` directly.
- `doubleAwait`
  - what: Await one service call; do not await a resolver and then await the service operation.
  - fix: Collapse to a single `await`.
- `resolver`
  - what: API options are static configuration, not per-request callbacks.
  - fix: Use context.app, context.actor(), context.authorize(), and validated input.

## `langwatch/awaited-return-chain`

- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-awaited-return-chain.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `awaitedReturnChain`
  - what: Name the awaited result before chaining properties or calls from it.
  - fix: Assign the awaited value to a const, then chain from the const.

Options: none.

Messages:

  - fix: Assign a group of them to a named const and test the name.

## `langwatch/condition-shape`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-condition-shape.feature`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `maxCalls` | integer | `1` | — |
| `maxHops` | integer | `2` | — |
| `maxOperators` | integer | `2` | — |

Messages:

- `nameCondition`
  - what: This condition takes {{hops}} property hops, {{calls}} calls and {{operators}} logical operators to read.
  - fix: Name it: assign it to a const and test the name.
  - why: A test nobody can read at a glance is where the wrong branch hides.

## `langwatch/fallible-result-naming`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isFallibleResultModule
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-fallible-result-naming.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `noResultType`
  - what: `{{name}}` has no explicit result type, so its absence contract cannot be enforced.
  - fix: Add an explicit return type.
- `nullableWithoutFind`
  - what: `{{name}}` can return null/undefined, but only a `find*` method may answer with absence.
  - fix: Throw the domain error and drop the nullable from the type, or name it `find*`.
- `requirePrefix`
  - what: Rename `{{name}}`: drop the `require` prefix; a method already returns or throws.
  - fix: Rename the method without the `require` prefix.
- `tryPrefix`
  - what: `{{name}}` hedges: a `try` method hands the caller a maybe instead of an answer.
  - fix: Name it `{{plain}}` and throw the domain error when it cannot answer; if absence is a normal outcome the caller branches on, name it `find*` and return undefined.

## `langwatch/feature-module-classes`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-feature-module-classes.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `abstract`
  - what: A strict feature port module must export an abstract {{suffix}} class.
  - fix: Export an abstract `*{{suffix}}` class.
- `concrete`
  - what: A strict feature runtime module must export a concrete {{suffix}} class.
  - fix: Export a concrete `*{{suffix}}` class.
- `create`
  - what: A concrete strict feature class must expose construction through static create.
  - fix: Add a static `create` method.
- `standalone`
  - what: Exported function in `{{path}}`: a `{{suffix}}` module keeps behaviour on its class.
  - fix: Move it onto the class or into `rules/`.

## `langwatch/feature-source-layout`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-feature-source-layout.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `contractFilename`
  - what: Rename `{{name}}` to `<subject>.<artifact>.ts` in lower kebab case, e.g. `trace-search.service.ts`.
  - fix: Use one of the canonical contract artifacts.
- `contractMissingSubject`
  - what: Rename `{{name}}` to `<subject>.{{artifact}}.ts`, e.g. `agent.commands.ts`.
  - fix: Add the subject to the filename.
- `contractServerArtifact`
  - what: Server artifact {{name}} cannot live in contract source.
  - fix: Move it to `server/src/<dir>/`.
- `processManagerService`
  - what: Rename `{{path}}` to `processes/<subject>.process.ts`; a process manager is not a service.
  - fix: Move the file to `processes/` and rename its `.service.ts` suffix to `.process.ts`.
- `rulesImpurity`
  - what: Rules module {{path}} may only export functions and constants (found {{found}}).
  - fix: Move the class or `new` into a service or adapter and pass its result in.
- `serverPath`
  - what: `{{path}}` has no home in layout v0. Allowed: services/, ports/, repository bundles and registries, stores/, adapters/, projections/, subscribers/, processes/, intents/, rules/, tasks/, transport/<surface>/ or transport/<feature>.<rest|trpc|ws>.ts, migrations/, app/, fixtures/, <feature>.server.ts.
  - fix: Move it to the directory matching its artifact suffix.

- Kind: problem

Options: none.

Messages:

## `langwatch/id-generation-origin`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-id-generation-origin.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `foreignIdModule`
  - what: `{{name}}` mints ids outside the house scheme.
  - fix: Import `generate` from `@langwatch/ksuid` and prefix the kind: `agent_${generate()}`.
  - why: A second id scheme neither sorts by time nor names its kind, and two schemes in one table are a migration.
- `randomUuid`
  - what: `randomUUID()` mints an id outside the house scheme.
  - fix: Import `generate` from `@langwatch/ksuid` and prefix the kind: `agent_${generate()}`.
  - why: A UUID neither sorts by time nor names its kind, and two schemes in one table are a migration.

## `langwatch/logical-statement-spacing`

- Kind: layout
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: whitespace
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-logical-statement-spacing.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `chainGroupSpacing`
  - what: Each .{{opener}}(...) group in a chain starts after one blank line.
  - fix: Add a blank line before the group.
- `paragraphSpacing`
  - what: A statement that spans several lines stands alone: one blank line before and after it.

- `statementSpacing`
  - what: Separate control-flow statements and non-sole return/throw statements with one blank line.
  - fix: Add a blank line.

## `langwatch/namespace-class`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-namespace-class.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `namespaceClass`
  - what: `{{name}}` has only static members ({{count}}), so it is a module wearing a class.
  - fix: Export the functions from a `rules/` module and delete the class.
  - why: A class earns its name by holding state; a bag of statics hides plain functions behind a namespace and a `create` nobody calls.

- Kind: problem

Options: none.

Messages:

- `nested`

## `langwatch/package-boundaries`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-package-boundaries.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `compositionRoot`
  - what: Only a composition root (`apps/api`, `apps/worker`, `apps/tasks`, `enterprise/packages/composition/*`) may import a feature server package.
  - fix: Import the feature's contract package here, or move this wiring into the composition root.
- `contractRuntime`
  - what: A contract package is transport-neutral: `{{specifier}}` is a node/browser/server runtime.
  - fix: Move this code to the server or web package and keep only types and schemas here.
- `coreImportsEnterprise`
  - what: Core code cannot import enterprise packages.
  - fix: Register the enterprise implementation through the composition root instead.
- `crossFeature`
  - what: `{{specifier}}` is another feature's server or web package.
  - fix: Import the same capability from `@langwatch/{{feature}}-contract`; if it is not exported there, add it to the contract first.
- `deadAlias`
  - what: `{{specifier}}` is a deleted alias (`~/`, `@app/`, `@ee/`).
  - fix: Import the module by its package name.
- `featureLayer`
  - what: `{{layer}}` cannot import `{{targetLayer}}`.
  - fix: Depend on the port or service instead and let the composition root supply the concrete adapter.
- `packageEscape`
  - what: This relative import leaves `{{packageRoot}}`.
  - fix: Import the target by its package name, or move the module into this package.
- `prismaContainment`
  - what: Prisma may be imported only by a server repository adapter under src/repositories/prisma.
  - fix: Move the query into a `*.repository.ts` there and call it through the service.
- `retiredPackageRuntime`
  - what: This package entry point belongs to a retired runtime or package surface.
  - fix: Use {{replacement}} instead.
- `schemaBoundary`
  - what: `{{specifier}}` binds the contract to Hono.
  - fix: Export a plain Zod/Standard Schema and let the transport adapt it.
- `sealedExports`
  - what: `{{subpath}}` is not in `{{package}}`'s `exports`.
  - fix: Import from a declared entry, or add the subpath to that package's `exports` if it is meant to be public.
- `serverImportsBrowser`
  - what: A server package cannot import `{{specifier}}` (browser).
  - fix: Move the browser-only value to the web package.
- `webImportsServer`
  - what: A web package cannot import a server package.
  - fix: Call the API the server exposes, or import the type from the contract.

## `langwatch/plan-literals`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isPlanFactSource
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-plan-literals.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `statesPlanFacts`
  - what: {{name}} states {{fields}} itself.
  - fix: Read them from the catalogue: `planCatalogue.plan("<TYPE>").limits` from @langwatch/plans. If this is a fixture, build it from `planCatalogue.plan(...)` and override the one field the test is about.
  - why: An object assigning two or more limit fields is a plan definition, and there is one catalogue of those.

## `langwatch/prisma-containment`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-prisma-containment.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `featurePrismaClient`
  - what: Feature packages cannot own Prisma connection or lifecycle services.
  - fix: Import `PrismaClient` as a type only and take the instance from the composition root; features do not own connections.
- `generatedPrisma`

## `langwatch/secrets-through-source`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-secrets-through-source.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `secret`
  - what: `{{key}}` is a classified secret and is read straight from the environment here.
  - fix: Resolve it through the SecretSource chain at the boot seam and pass the typed value in.
  - why: A secret read directly skips classification, the source chain and log redaction.

## `langwatch/service-classes`

- Kind: style
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-service-classes.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `create`
  - what: A service class must expose construction through a static create method.
  - fix: Add a static `create` method and make the constructor private.
- `missing`
  - what: A service module must define a class whose name ends in Service.
  - fix: Export a `*Service` class from this module.
- `standalone`
  - what: Exported function `{{name}}` in a service module: make it a method on the `*Service` class, or a private module-level helper (not exported).
  - fix: Move the behaviour onto the class, or stop exporting the helper.

## `langwatch/service-dependencies`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-service-dependencies.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `databaseClient`
  - what: A service cannot import a database client; persistence belongs behind its own repository.
  - fix: Move the import behind a `*.repository.ts` and depend on that instead.
- `foreignRepository`
  - what: `{{specifier}}` is another subject's repository.
  - fix: Depend on that subject's service instead; a service owns only its own repository.
- `globalApplication`
  - what: A service cannot recover the global application graph.
  - fix: Inject the service dependency explicitly.

## `langwatch/service-quality`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-service-quality.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `duplicateMember`
  - what: A service class cannot declare the member {{name}} more than once.
  - fix: Remove or rename one of the declarations.

## `langwatch/temporal-only`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isTemporalOnlySource
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-temporal-only.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `constructInstant`
  - what: {{name}} builds a Date out of a value.
  - fix: Use `Temporal.Instant.from(iso)` for an ISO string, `Temporal.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(ms)` for a millisecond count, or `fromDate(date)` from @langwatch/time when a boundary handed you a Date.
- `dateType`
  - what: {{name}} is typed `Date`.
  - fix: Declare it `Temporal.Instant` from @langwatch/time, or `string` when the value only ever comes off the wire, and convert with `toDate()` at the Prisma or SDK boundary.
  - why: A Date on a declared type invites one to be minted to satisfy it.
- `mintNow`
  - what: {{name}} mints a Date for the current moment.
  - fix: Call `nowInstant()` from @langwatch/time.
  - why: One clock: every moment in the product is a Temporal.Instant.
- `mintNowMilliseconds`
  - what: {{name}} reads the current moment as Date epoch milliseconds.
  - fix: Call `nowInstant().epochMilliseconds` from @langwatch/time.
- `parseInstant`
  - what: {{name}} parses a moment through Date.
  - fix: Use `Temporal.Instant.from(iso).epochMilliseconds` from @langwatch/time.
- `utcInstant`
  - what: {{name}} builds an epoch count out of calendar parts through Date.
  - fix: Build the moment with `Temporal.PlainDateTime.from({ year, month, day }).toZonedDateTime("UTC").epochMilliseconds` from @langwatch/time.

## `langwatch/typed-prisma-seam`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: every file
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-typed-prisma-seam.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `cast`
  - what: `as PrismaClient` is not permitted.
  - fix: The composition adapter takes a typed PrismaClient and hands it to the repository.
- `databaseObject`
  - what: `database: object` in a `.create(` argument list forces a cast at the seam.
  - fix: Type the parameter as PrismaClient and take it from the composition root.

## `langwatch/unbounded-loop`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-unbounded-loop.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `unboundedLoop`
  - what: This `{{form}}` loop states no exit condition in its header.
  - fix: Put the deadline or the retry budget in the header, or move the waiting into a method whose signature carries it.
  - why: When the exit lives in the body the reader has to find every return, break and throw to know when the loop ends.

## `langwatch/web-imports-server-shaped-value`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: applies
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-web-imports-server-shaped-value.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `serverShaped`
  - what: A browser module value-imports `{{name}}`, whose declarations are the server's and pull a database graph into the browser program.
  - fix: Import it as a type only, or reach the capability through a first-party module that the browser already owns.
  - why: Loading declaration files is the largest bucket in a type-check, and this class of import is invisible in the bundle.

## `langwatch/zod-object-composition`

- Kind: problem
- Applies to: isSchemaSource
- Fixable: no
- Spec: `specs/tooling/lint-zod-object-composition.feature`

Options: none.

Messages:

- `keepRefinements`
  - what: This Zod object carries refinements before .{{method}}().
  - fix: Use .safeExtend() to retain refinements, or apply the refinements to the final composed object.
  - why: Spreading its shape alone would discard those checks.
- `spreadShape`
  - what: Zod .{{method}}() composes object types through mapped generics.
  - fix: Compose with z.object({ ...base.shape, ...fields }); preserve strictness and catchalls with the matching object constructor and .catchall(). Use .safeExtend() when refinement or assignability checks must be retained.
  - why: Shape spreads avoid repeated generic instantiation when constructing derived schemas.
